conservative_band_basis: Anchors whose holdout value is at least 1.5x the random-placement floor. Only the two catalogue-hugging d1.5/d2.8 variants qualify, and they are the closest thing to a like-for-like comparison in the set.
parity_band_basis: An anchor is admissible only if (a) its implied estimate is inside [0, 1] and (b) it beats the random-placement floor, i.e. its holdout actually measured fault recovery. Nine of the eleven anchors score BELOW a uniformly random 55,000-dot placement on this holdout, so their owner-reported scores were earned by something the holdout cannot see.
why_no_point_estimate: The eleven anchors carry owner-reported scores inside a 12% band (0.2477-0.2778) but their holdout values span 0.0067-0.1718, a 25x spread. The holdout-to-leaderboard map is therefore not identifiable here, and any single projected number would be fabricated. Ratio spread across all eleven anchors: 25.6x.
empirical_refutation: GEMSDOE32 B2 (owner-reported 0.2778, the highest) measures HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0067, while the lower-scored d1.5 file (0.2477) measures 0.1718. The ordering inverts, so a monotone transfer assumption is refuted by our own two flagship anchors.
why_this_is_expected: The holdout scores recovery of mapped faults. The organizers mask mapped faults out of scoring in writing, so a submission's catalogue recall is worth nothing on the leaderboard. B2 deleted exactly the near-catalogue dots that the holdout credits, and its reported score rose - which is consistent only if those dots were earning nothing on the leaderboard.
direction_of_bias_on_the_band: Optimistic for a catalogue-hugging rival and neutral for us: our holdout value is earned without catalogue recall, so the same number should survive the mask better.
assumptions: The owner-reported scores are attached to the bytes we measured (unverified; no receipt).
Holdout parity implies leaderboard parity for submissions of similar kind.
what_would_make_it_estimable: Two submissions with organizer receipts on the same artifact family.
Or an explicit statement that the public score and the holdout share a monotone map.
